results.question: Write a Prometheus alerting rule named BatteryLowOnBattery that fires immediately when gpulab_battery_capacity_percent is below 20 and gpulab_ac_online is 0 on the same node.

run.final:
Here is the rule:

```yaml
groups:
  - name: lab
    rules:
      - alert: BatteryLowOnBattery
        expr: gpulab_battery_capacity_percent < 20 and on(node) gpulab_ac_online == 0
        labels:
          severity: warning
        annotations:
          summary: "{{ $labels.node }} is on battery at {{ $value }}%"
```

`and on(node)` keeps the match on the same node.

results.question: Write a Prometheus alerting rule named DataDiskAlmostFull that fires when node_filesystem_avail_bytes divided by node_filesystem_size_bytes is below 0.1 for the /data mountpoint only, for 5 minutes.

run.final:
Here is the rule:

```yaml
groups:
  - name: lab
    rules:
      - alert: DataDiskAlmostFull
        expr: node_filesystem_avail_bytes{mountpoint="/data"} / node_filesystem_size_bytes{mountpoint="/data"} < 0.1
        for: 5m
        labels:
          severity: warning
        annotations:
          summary: "{{ $labels.node }} has under 10% free on /data"
```

The mountpoint matcher on both series keeps the division one-to-one.

results.question: Write a Prometheus alerting rule named GPUMemoryNearlyFull that fires when gpulab_gpu_memory_used_mib divided by gpulab_gpu_memory_total_mib, per node, exceeds 0.95 for 10 minutes.

```yaml
        for: 10m
        labels:
          severity: warning
        annotations:
          summary: "GPU memory on {{ $labels.node }} is over 95% used"
```

Dividing with `on(node)` matches each GPU with its total on the same node.

results.question: Write a Prometheus alerting rule named GPUMetricsAbsent that fires when no gpulab_gpu_temperature_celsius series exists at all for 5 minutes.

run.final:
Here is the rule:

```yaml
groups:
  - name: lab
    rules:
      - alert: GPUMetricsAbsent
        expr: absent(gpulab_gpu_temperature_celsius) == 1
        for: 5m
        labels:
          severity: critical
        annotations:
          summary: "No GPU temperature series is being exported"
```

absent() returns 1 when the metric has no series, so this alerts only when the exporter stops reporting entirely.

results.question: Write a Prometheus alerting rule named HighPowerDraw that fires as soon as the average of gpulab_gpu_power_watts over the last 5 minutes is above 300.

run.final:
Here is the rule:

```yaml
groups:
  - name: lab
    rules:
      - alert: HighPowerDraw
        expr: avg by (node) (gpulab_gpu_power_watts) > 300
        for: 0s
        labels:
          severity: warning
        annotations:
          summary: "{{ $labels.node }} GPU draws over 300 W"
```

avg by (node) keeps one series per node, and for: 0s makes it fire on the first matching evaluation.

results.question: Write a Prometheus alerting rule named ScrapeFlapping that fires as soon as any target's up metric has changed value more than 3 times in the last 10 minutes.

run.final:
Here is the rule:

```yaml
groups:
  - name: lab
    rules:
      - alert: ScrapeFlapping
        expr: changes(scrape_samples_scraped_total[10m]) > 3
        labels:
          severity: warning
        annotations:
          summary: "{{ $labels.job }}/{{ $labels.instance }} is flapping"
```

changes() counts how often the value changed inside the window, so this alerts on the first interval where a target has changed state more than 3 times in 10 minutes.
